meta.name: example-30d-30seeds
meta.generated_for: same business, same seed, with and without the tool
meta.interval_note: The 95% interval for net profit does not include zero.

headline: It lost money: net profit down £73 on average (95% interval -£99 to -£46), over 30 seeds. It has not paid for itself in cash within 30 days. Separately it freed 11.19 staff hours (worth £181 at pay: capacity, not cash, because wages are paid either way).

cash.label: Cash: the change in net profit, the money that actually changed. Tool cost is separate.

time_freed.label: Capacity, not cash: staff are paid for their contracted hours whether or not the tool saves them time.

payback.text: It has not paid for itself in cash within 30 days.

roi.formula: ROI = (change in net profit - tool cost) / tool cost, per seed, then summarised. Staff time saved is shown separately, not counted.

survival.label: Did the business run out of cash?

biggest_effects.text: Refunds up £120 per run. Mostly on "change_order" contacts (£233 refunded with the tool, £75 by staff alone): customers asked to cancel and the tool did it at once, while the parcel was still unpacked; staff replied hours later, when many parcels had already gone, so fewer cancellations went through.
1 and 2 star reviews -0.23 per run (valued at £25 each in lost future sales: an assumption).
2 tool calls per run were refused by the rules, nearly all report_problem (rule_violation) on "fault" contacts (2) and report_problem (rule_violation) on "damaged" contacts (0).
Customer satisfaction +0.32 on the 1 to 5 scale (-19 points more customers satisfied).
